description: From the waterfront promenade, the monastery's Romanesque bulk rises above the lamplit walk, its towers and portal glowing warm against the night sky. Below, the promenade stretches along the bay with its row of lamps reflected in the dark water, and moored boats sway gently offshore. Porta Ferrada has watched over this harbor for a thousand years — tonight it keeps its quiet vigil over Sant Feliu.
